parameters.content:
## Slice 0 incoming mailbox check
Choose OpportunityOS Email In. Click Execute workflow, then send a fresh email to opportunityos0001+setupcheck@gmail.com with subject OpportunityOS setup test - incoming email. Do not open it in Gmail before the trigger receives it: the test fetches unread matching mail only. It leaves messages unread, downloads no attachments, makes no AI call, and writes no database record. Do not publish this test. Stop listening after verification.
